### 2. Your role

Design selected systems to purchased maturity; retain load/airflow/pressure/selection calculations. AC is not outdoor air; resolve missing loads/evidence.
Fire engineer owns strategy/solutions; mechanical implements selected plant/fire modes. Trades install/program/test; review/witnessing is not execution, continuous supervision or unseen-work certification.

### 3. Scope by stage

R2 defines output maturity/formats/reliance/revisions/rounds/dates. Options are priced on their own and are not in the base fee.

| Stage | Deliverable at sign-off |
|---|---|
| S1 Evidence | Brief/system-space register; accessible review, observed/tested/assumed condition/capacity/life; gaps/owners |
| S3 Concept | Options/preliminary loads/zones, plant/routes/replacement access, intakes/discharges/acoustics/cost inputs |
| S4 Planning | Listed spatial sketches or formal plans/reports; screening/noise/energy inputs, submissions and bounded responses |
| S5 Design | Load/airflow/pressure/selection calculations, layouts/schedules, refrigerant/condensate, energy/controls/fire modes; structure/envelope/power/access coordination |
| S6 Documentation | Traditional design/calculations/specs; D&C performance/intent, retained/delegated design/test criteria; RFIs/addenda/comparison |
| S7 Post-contract (option) | Retained design/substitutions/declarations; settle novation duties/fee. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S8 Construction (option) | RFIs/submittals/equipment, hold-point reports/concealed-work limits, test plans/defects. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S9 Commissioning (option) | Scripts/results; balancing/controls/fire/failure/recovery witnesses, expected/actual/defects/retests; as-builts/O&M/settings/trends/training/residuals. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S10 Seasonal (option) | Deferred seasonal/tuning/defect reviews, weather/operation prerequisites, closure. A later stage the client may commission. |
| S11 Advisory (option) | Decision/extent/cutoff/reliance/method/confidence/actions; separate diagnosis/remedy/verification; reviewer is not designer. A later stage the client may commission. |

### 5. Scope position

Service levels are set for a simple project; technical items follow the project's own facts.
Included in the fee: Selected detailed HVAC design: duties/air paths/outdoor air; loads/hours/reserve; Toilet/laundry/refuse/car-park/charging exhaust; make-up air/discharge separation; Kitchen/process exhaust; equipment brief/specialist, not kitchenette; Smoke fans/shafts/dampers/pressurisation under fire-engineer strategy; wet fire separate; BMS sequences/points/alarms/metering; programming/licences/commissioning owners; Coordinate supports/plinths/openings/power/refrigerant leak/condensate; respective specialists design; Declarations/lodgement; verify jurisdiction/competence, no approval guarantee.
Optional: price each on its own line in R1: Occupied/phased temporary ventilation/isolation/handback by use/phase; Diagnosis/trial/verification; no whole-building conclusion from samples; Separate continued design/novation; Quantified construction support; Selected witnessing/handover; Seasonal/defects reviews; Test execution separately priced to named contractors.
Excluded: the party named does it: Whole-building energy/rating only; mechanical inputs remain in appointed design (energy assessor); Acoustic/envelope design only; mechanical noise inputs remain in appointed design (acoustic consultant / architect, not yet engaged); Laboratory/clean-room/medical gases/process refrigeration/hazardous areas (competent specialist).
Tell us in R6 if you disagree with any line. Do not add your own general exclusions; any you add are treated as non-compliant.

**Responsibility schedule**: Condensate: agree hydraulic/mechanical connection point/level, receiving capacity, falls/traps/tundish/discharge; name upstream/downstream design/install/test owners. Unresolved allocation stays open. R4 names strategy/cause-and-effect authors, mechanical designer, programmer, power/network provider, test performer/leader/witness.

### 6. Terms

- Engage under Project mechanical agreement (attached), scope/fees/addenda and written acceptance; settle conflicts/precedence. RFP authorises no work.
- Written authority before scope/quantity/ceiling/rate/program changes; state reason/system/approval and cost/time.
- Approved brief/revisions set baseline; ordinary coordination/development included.
- Own-error correction included; reasonable professional skill/care within competence.
- Payment 30 days from correct milestone invoices; R6 declares prepayment/release conditions, interest/recovery/suspension.
- State rate hold/escalation; preapprove extras/expenses; no duplicate package fees.
- Valid 90 days after closing; ex GST/GST/total, base/options separate.
- Questions to Project manager by 2026-10-23; numbered addenda to all, acknowledged in R1.
- Agree project copying/distribution/operation/alteration rights, native files/reliance/retention/termination handover; confidentiality permits authorised/lawful disclosure; marketing by consent.
- Settle caps/indemnities, law/disputes, notices/cure/suspension/termination, assignment/novation/subcontracts; insurance is not a cap; conflicts/staff changes agreed.

### 7. Evaluation

Price 40% · Experience 20% · Team 20% · Method/program 10% · Compliance 10%. Compare equal systems, evidence, maturity, interfaces and test/attendance duties.
